An inadvertent encounter with clear air turbulence during descent.

The pilot’s failure to maintain clearance from power lines during a low level aerial application.

The pilot’s failure to disengage the autopilot prior to climbing out of a fog bank.

The fatigue failure of the tail rotor pitch change link spherical bearing housing as a result of corrosion pitting.

The pilot's inadvertent encounter with instrument meteorological conditions resulting in spatial disorientation, loss of control, and subsequent impact with terrain.
